First release of the OctoPrint / Prusa XL edition of the card.

**New**
- OctoPrint and PrusaLink support, auto-detected from your entities (no `entity_mappings` needed)
- Prusa XL view: tool-changer drawing with docks, one temperature per installed tool, settable tool targets
- 4×4 heatbed segment heatmap in the Temps sheet
- Friendly names for Prusa's extra readings: Mainboard, Tool N heatbreak
- Compact layout: progress / elapsed / ETA in one panel (ETA shows finish time), even temperature row, equal-width buttons
- `font_scale`, `tool_count`, `exclude`, `active_tool` and `show_diagnostic_sensors` options

**Fixes**
- Empty XL tool slots (reporting ~6 °C) are hidden
- Works from a single file, so HACS installs no longer fall back to Klipper entity names
- Tolerates a trailing underscore in `base_entity`
